subject.title: Fix subagent announce restart recovery cascade

question: After the message-tool-only delivery gap is fixed, should this PR land with the announce-specific persisted recovery marker and tool-boundary model?
rationale: The code defect is mechanically fixable, but the final persisted `announceLastRun` state transition and special tool boundary are compatibility and security-boundary choices that need owner signoff.

options.title: Fix delivery path, then land
options.body: Preserve delivery-only message behavior while keeping code/file/native tools disabled, then rerun lint and land if the persisted recovery state is acceptable.

options.title: Choose a different recovery state
options.body: If `killed` is not the desired terminal state for aborted delivery-only announce runs, update the reconciliation state before merge.

options.title: Pause for broader delivery design
options.body: If announce-specific markers are too narrow, pause this PR and route the broader subagent completion delivery model first.

recommendation.title: Fix delivery path, then land
recommendation.body: Preserve delivery-only message behavior while keeping code/file/native tools disabled, then rerun lint and land if the persisted recovery state is acceptable.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently touched both the restart recovery lifecycle seam and the Codex internal message-tool registration behavior that frame this decision.
